text: {"hypotheses":[{"statement":"The newly approved 2400 H100 GPU‑hour quota should be allocated first to the ablation study requested by Reviewer 2 (rewrite operations vs naive append), and the same compute can be used to evaluate the consolidation technique from the arXiv paper (which reduces cross‑fact interference) as an additional experimental condition, thereby simultaneously satisfying the review requirement and testing a promising memory‑efficiency method.","confidence":0.82,"support_ids":["9186bc5a","559abff0","13b3b6fa"],"tags":["ablation","compute-allocation","memory-consolidation"]},{"statement":"Combining MemGPT’s virtual context‑paging mechanism with the periodic consolidation approach described in the recent arXiv paper could yield a hybrid memory system that mitigates interference more effectively than either rewrite‑based or naive‑append strategies, providing novel material for the agent‑memory benchmark workshop paper co‑authored with Maya.","confidence":0.76,"support_ids":["f1fbdbac","13b3b6fa","512ae861"],"tags":["hybrid-memory","benchmark","workshop-paper"]}]}
